# HANGUK SKIN

> HANGUK SKIN (Hanguk Skin Private Limited) is an Indian company based in Gurugram, Haryana. It is the official importer and distributor of genuine Korean beauty brands in India. It carries Korean brands only, imports them through official channels, and supplies retail stores, retail chains and online marketplace sellers across India with marketing support.

## Key facts
- Legal name: Hanguk Skin Private Limited (CIN U46491HR2026PTC147722)
- Registered office: 703, 7th Floor, Palm Court, Sector-16, MG Road, Gurugram, Haryana 122007, India
- Contact: WhatsApp and phone +91 62832 89326
- "Hanguk" means Korea in Korean. Slogan: "Only Korean. Only official."
- Korean brands only. No grey-market or parallel imports.
- CDSCO import registration; the registration number (RC No.) and HANGUK SKIN's importer details are printed on every pack.
- Stock held in a bonded FTWZ warehouse in India.
- Partners can request import registration, invoices and batch details.
- Marketing support: marketplace listings, ads and reviews; in-store displays, sampling and staff training; social and creator content.
- Categories: skincare, sun care, cleansers, sheet masks, makeup.
